definitions.short: a wavering , i.e. fall ; by implication, a pole (as shaking); hence, a yoke (as essentially a bent pole)
definitions.full: H4132. mot מוֺט noun [masculine] shaking, pole, bar of yoke ; — absolute ׳מ Num 4:10 5 t.; suffix מֹטֵ֫הוּ Nahum 1:13 ; — 1 a shaking; tottering (c. negative, of security) ׳מ לֹאיִֿתֵּן לַצַּדִּיק Psa 55:23 ; לַמ נָתַן ׳לֹא רַגְלֵנוּ 66:9 , compare 121:3 . 2 pole , or bar for carrying (named from springing motion) Num 4:10 , 12 compare especially 13:23 . 3 bar of yoke Nahum 1:13 ( מֵעָלַיַךְ מֹטֵהוּ אֶשְׁבֹּר ), figurative of oppression. compare following.
